description: This source file contains automated unit tests for the Data Asset Backend system, specifically testing the correctness of copying assets and their associated data subtrees in a database-backed environment. The tests verify that source assets remain unchanged while copies are created with new IDs, ensuring proper lineage, and that related sub-entities (ef source mappings, throughput equations, scalars, and data input values) are correctly replicated with new identifiers and content integrity.

classes.name: DbBackedCopyReplicationCorrectnessTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying the correctness of copying assets with their associated input parameters and related sub-entities in a database-backed system, ensuring new IDs, content consistency, and unaltered source data.

methods.name: Copy_asset_replicates_input_subtree_with_new_ids_and_preserves_source
methods.description: Main test case that creates a complex asset with input parameters, mappings, equations, scalars, and data values, then copies it. The test verifies that the copy results in new IDs and preserved content, while the source remains unchanged.
